lines.t: (Verse 1)
Yeah, I grew up in a war zone, love was never in the plans
Mama broken, daddy ghostin’, I was raised by empty hands
Cold nights, no hugs, just the echoes and the sin
Only arms that ever held me was the bottle and the gin
Heart numb, I was runnin’ with the killers in the dark
Tryna flex like I’m a lion, but I’m dyin’ in my heart
Every woman that I touched, man, I used her then I dipped
’Cause nobody ever taught me what it means for love to stick(Pre-Chorus)
But when the smoke clears, it’s just me and my fear
Hands bloody from the fight, but You still drawin’ near
I heard You whisper in the madness, cuttin’ through the lies
“Son, I took your pain and nailed it when they pierced Me in My side”(Hook)
Daddy YahuShua, I’m cryin’ out tonight
I don’t know what love is, I been searchin’ all my life
Take this stone heart, break it, set it all on fire
Destroy me in Your love, You the only One I desire
Daddy YahuShua, hold me when I fall
All these demons on my back, but I’m answerin’ Your call
I been bleedin’ in the dark, now I’m reachin’ for the light
Teach me what love is, won’t You father me tonight(Verse 2)
Flashbacks of the belt whips, curses in my ear
“Boy, you ain’t gon’ be nothin’,” that’s the only voice I hear
So I went and made an image, built a throne outta pride
Gold chains, black heart, tryna cover what’s inside
I was drownin’ in the women, in the money, in the smoke
Every laugh that left my lips was just a bullet in a joke
I was starvin’ for affection, but I’d bite the hand that fed
’Cause every hand that ever fed me left me hungry in the end(Pre-Chorus)
But even in my vomit, rollin’ round in my sin
You were standin’ in the doorway sayin’, “Son, just come in”
Scars in Your hands, love bleedin’ from Your eyes
You said, “I took your shame when I hung and when I died”(Hook)
Daddy YahuShua, I’m cryin’ out tonight
I don’t know what love is, I been searchin’ all my life
Take this stone heart, break it, set it all on fire
Destroy me in Your love, You the only One I desire
Daddy YahuShua, hold me when I fall
All these demons on my back, but I’m answerin’ Your call
I been bleedin’ in the dark, now I’m reachin’ for the light
Teach me what love is, won’t You father me tonight(Bridge)
I put the pistol on the table, I put the mask on the floor
I’m tired of kickin’ down these doors, I’m walkin’ through Yours
If love is a cross, then I’m layin’ right there
If love is Your blood, let it drip in my hair
If love is Your voice in the storm sayin’, “Peace, be still”
Then kill every idol, every lust, every will
If love is Your wrath on the sin that I own
Then break me to pieces, but don’t leave me alone(Verse 3)
Now I’m standin’ in the ruins of the man I used to be
You took the dope boy, turned him to a son on his knees
All the pain from my childhood, You been stitchin’ every seam
You the Father I been chasin’ in my nightmares and my dreams
I ain’t hard ’cause I’m tough, I was hard ’cause I’m hurt
Now I’m layin’ all my trauma in the hem of Your shirt
If they ask me what I’m bangin’, I ain’t reppin’ no block
I’m reppin’ nails in Your hands and the blood on that cross(Pre-Chorus)
You said, “Son, I never left, I was there in every tear
I was holdin’ you in secret when the hate filled your ears
You ain’t got a earn My love, I paid it with My own
Now come and lose your life in Me and I’ma bring you home”(Alternate Hook – outro style, softer)
Daddy YahuShua, I’m layin’ down my fight
Wrap Your arms around me, pull me closer to Your side
Take this cold heart, melt it, set it all on fire
Destroy me in Your love, You the only One I desire
Daddy YahuShua, whisper to my soul
Tell me that I’m yours, that I’m loved, that I’m whole
I was bleedin’ in the dark, now I’m standin’ in Your light
Now I know what love is, You my Father, You my life
